## US-01-01 spec-compliance review, round 3 (PR #3, head e83aaef)

B1 is really fixed and nothing broke. All five criteria are met or covered by external evidence. I found no blocking item. The one thing stopping a merge has nothing to do with the code: **CI on e83aaef failed before the tests started, so there is no `og-test-results` artifact for this head.** The job needs a re-run.

### CI on e83aaef (run 38561630611)
- **Result:** failure after 1m45s, in the emulator runner's "Install Android SDK" step. Downloading `system-images;android-31;google_apis;x86_64` failed with "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the emulator never booted.
- **Script never ran:** `yarn test:acceptance` did not start.
- **Artifact:** the og-test-results upload failed with "No files were found". **It holds no result for any required test.**
- **Previous head:** CI on b9a4b6d (run 38557153663) was green. I downloaded its og-test-results (into the scratchpad): AC-01-01-1, -3 and -5 (Jest), TC-00-01, TC-00-03 and TC-01-01 (Maestro, API 31), and AC-01-01-4 (Maestro release run plus its precondition and logcat checks) all passed. That head is not the one under review, though.
- **Fix:** `gh run rerun 38561630611`. I did not trigger it because I work read-only.

### Local evidence on e83aaef
`test-runs/2026-10-14_140555` was run on e83aaef with a clean tree, on an API 32 emulator.
- **Release checks (`junit/release.xml`):** 6 of 6 pass — AC-01-01-5 steps 4–6, AC-01-01-3 step 2, the AC-01-01-4 precondition and the logcat check.
- **Debug-build flows (`maestro/report.xml`):** TC-00-01, TC-00-03 and TC-01-01 pass.
- **Release flow (`maestro/report-release.xml`):** AC-01-01-4 passes.
- **Unit tests (`junit/unit.xml`):** 15 of 15 pass.
- **My own re-run:** Jest 15/15, `lint`, `tsc` and `format:check` are all green. `bash -n` on the script is fine.
- **Secrets in logs:** zero matches for storepass/keypass/password assignments in `release-build.log`, `stack.log` and `acceptance.log`.

One thing outside this diff: the og collector's `run.json` lists AC-01-01-1, -3 and -5 as "skipped" even though their JUnit cases passed. The collector only matches Maestro output by `TC-` folder name. This is a tooling limit, not the implementer's.

### B1 and the round-2 fixes
| Item | Verdict | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B1 [security] env wins over gradle.properties | Fixed | `plugins/withReleaseSigning.js:19` now reads `System.getenv(name) ?: findProperty(name)`. The generated `android/app/build.gradle:86` matches. The test at `plugins/__tests__/withReleaseSigning.test.js:56-65` checks the lookup order and that no `KQ_UPLOAD_*` value is read outside `kqUpload`; with the old order it would fail. |
| B1: no stale `android/` left behind | Holds | Prebuild cleans by default in this Expo CLI (`clean: !args['--no-clean']`), and under `CI=1` it goes on even with a dirty tree. The local run's log shows "Cleared android code". So the idempotency guard (`withReleaseSigning.js:52`) cannot keep an old lookup during the acceptance run. |
| DEC-45 | Recorded, append-only | `docs/specs/DECISIONS.md` only gains lines in the PR diff. README:55-56 and AC-01-01-5 step 2 match it. |
| N1 fail fast with no device | Fixed | `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:52-56`, README:42-46 |
| N2 fresh-clone install | Fixed | `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:58-62` |
| N3 Maestro missing counted as a failure | Fixed, with a weak label | `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:185` (see N3 below) |
| N7 no password in argv | Fixed | keytool uses `-storepass:env`/`-keypass:env` (`:126-129`); Gradle gets the values through the environment (`:134-136`) |

### Criteria, Covers and edge case
| Item | Verdict | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #1 latest foundation, versions recorded | met | README:6-17; `tests/unit/AC-01-01-1-platform-versions.test.js`, `plugins/__tests__/withMinSdk.test.js` pass |
| #2 installs and starts on Android 12 emulator and Kompakt | external | Kompakt part is MANUAL TC-01-03. Emulator part: TC-01-01 passed locally on e83aaef (API 32) and in CI on API 31 at b9a4b6d. |
| #3 no network permission | met | `plugins/withReleaseNoNetwork.js` with its unit test; `aapt` on the release APK lists none (`release/permissions.txt`) |
| #4 starts and runs with network off | met | AC-01-01-4: the flow, the precondition (bundle embedded, not debuggable, no bundler, no `adb reverse`) and the logcat check all pass |
| #5 signed release APK, key outside the repo | met | Steps 1–3 are unit tests; steps 4–6 (apksigner shows the throwaway DN, sdkVersion 31) are in `release.xml` |
| MOD-01-F01, NFR-05, -06, -10, -13 | delivered | As above. There are no HTTP libraries in `dependencies`. |
| NFR-12 | delivered for this story's scope | Playing offline is deferred to TC-01-02 / US-03-01 by DEC-44 |
| Edge case: device older than Android 12 | implemented and tested | `withMinSdk` plus the `aapt` check `sdkVersion:'31'` (STEP6) |
| Out of scope | no violations | Every line of the fix diff traces to B1/DEC-45 or N1/N2/N3/N7 |
| Constitution | no violations | — |

### Findings (all non-blocking)
- **N1, CI on e83aaef:** the merge gate is not satisfied because the emulator image download failed (infrastructure, not code). Re-run the job and check the artifact.
- **N2, `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:53-56`:** the no-device exit writes no JUnit, not even the unit tests. On CI this surfaces as a confusing "No files were found" upload error. Fix: run `write_junit` with a recorded failure before `exit 1`.
- **N3, `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:185`:** a missing Maestro is recorded under the AC-01-01-4 precondition's name ("release build installed, no bundler reachable"). TC-00-01, TC-00-03, TC-01-01 and the AC-01-01-4 flow get no failing entry at all. Fix: record a dedicated "Maestro flows" case, or one failing case per flow.
- **N4, `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:53`:** the preflight finds a device but doesn't pin it. With the emulator and the Kompakt both on USB, every bare `adb` call fails with "more than one device", and Maestro may pick either device. Fix: export `ANDROID_SERIAL` from the preflight and pass `--device` to maestro.
- **N5, `scripts/test-acceptance.sh:59` (same check in `stack.sh:46`):** `yarn install` that reports "Already up-to-date" doesn't refresh `.yarn-integrity`. After a checkout touches `yarn.lock`, every run reinstalls; the local log shows this. Fix: `touch node_modules/.yarn-integrity` after a successful install.
- **N6, `plugins/__tests__/withReleaseSigning.test.js:56-59`:** DEC-45 is only proven by reading the generated Groovy; no build shows env overriding a Gradle property. Fix: in the acceptance build, also set the non-secret `ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_KQ_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS=not-this-alias`. The APK must still be signed with the throwaway DN.
- **N7, PR #3 description:** it still says signing comes "from ~/.gradle/gradle.properties or the environment". Its Decisions section lacks DEC-45, and its local run reference (`2026-10-14_120331` on f06b45e) is out of date. Fix: update the body to the e83aaef run and DEC-45.

### Paths
- `/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/plugins/withReleaseSigning.js`
- `/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/plugins/__tests__/withReleaseSigning.test.js`
- `/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/scripts/test-acceptance.sh`
- `/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/test-runs/2026-10-14_140555/`
- `/Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/specs/DECISIONS.md`
